SELECT r.id, r.type, r.status, r.completed_at, r.title, r.description, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.location, r.occurred_at, r.contact, r.publisher_name, r.publisher_id, r.pair_state, r.deleted_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM t_record r LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = r.category_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_record (type, status, title, description, category_id, location, occurred_at, contact, publisher_name, publisher_id) VALUES (#{type}, #{status}, #{title}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{location}, #{occurredAt}, #{contact}, #{publisherName}, #{publisherId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_record SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, location = #{location}, occurred_at = #{occurredAt}, contact = #{contact}, publisher_name = #{publisherName}, pair_state = 'PENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE t_record SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE t_record SET status = 'CLOSED', completed_at = NULL, updated_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE t_record SET deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, updated_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.type, r.status, r.completed_at, r.title, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.location, r.occurred_at, r.publisher_id, r.created_at FROM t_record r LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = r.category_id WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND AND r.id IN #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM t_record r WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.status <> 'CLOSED' AND ( (r.pair_state IN ('PENDING', 'SCORING') AND (r.pair_scored_at IS NULL OR r.pair_scored_at < #{staleBefore})) OR r.pair_state = 'DEGRADED' ) ORDER BY (r.pair_scored_at IS NULL) DESC, r.pair_scored_at ASC, r.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
